name: 12dpl-debugger
description: Step-through debugging for 12d Model macros (12dPL) via source instrumentation and the Debug Adapter Protocol.

outDir.description: Folder the instrumented copy of the macro is written to. Compile and run the entry file from here.

stopOnEntry.description: Pause on the first line of main.

compileCommand.description: Optional compiler to run after instrumenting, e.g. "\"C:/Program Files/12d/.../cc4d.exe\" \"${file}\"" or a list [program, arg, ...]. It is started directly, without PowerShell or cmd, so it must be an .exe. ${file} is replaced with the instrumented entry file, ${outDir} with outDir.

pollIntervalMs.description: How often the adapter checks for messages from 12d.

inspectors.description: Functions that show what is inside a value with no text form, written as 12dPL signatures. The first parameter is the inspected value and each & parameter becomes a member, e.g. "Integer Get_name(Element elt, Text &name)". Other parameters can be literals: "Integer Get_attribute(Element elt, \"width\", Real &width)". Inspectors for a type replace the built-in ones for that type (Element: name, type, points, model; Model: name, items).

inspectDepth.description: How many levels of inspected members to expand (an Element's model's members are level 2).

includePaths.description: Extra folders to look in for #include "..." files, after the including file's folder and the entry file's folder (e.g. the 12d project folder).

trace.description: Log every message to and from the macro in the Debug Console (for diagnosing stepping problems).

12dpl.stopOnEntry.description: Pause on the first line of main.

12dpl.inspectors.markdownDescription: Functions that show what is inside values with no text form, as 12dPL signatures. The first parameter is the inspected value and each `&` parameter becomes a member, e.g. `Integer Get_name(Element elt, Text &name)`. Literals can fill other parameters: `Integer Get_attribute(Element elt, "width", Real &width)`. The built-in ones are listed; edit, remove or add lines. Blank lines are ignored, and one that can't be read is skipped with a warning in the Debug Console.

12dpl.inspectDepth.description: How many levels of inspected members to expand.

12dpl.includePaths.description: Extra folders to look in for #include "..." files, after the including file's folder and the entry file's folder (e.g. the 12d project folder).

12dpl.compileCommand.markdownDescription: Optional compiler (an `.exe`) run after instrumenting, started directly without a shell. `${file}` is the instrumented entry file, `${outDir}` the output folder.

12dpl.compilerPath.markdownDescription: 12d's macro compiler (`cc4d.exe`), used by **12dPL: Build Companion Macro**.

12dpl.compilerCpath.markdownDescription: `CPATH` for `cc4d.exe` (folders separated by `:`, as 12d does). Empty: use `CPATH` from the environment if set, otherwise work it out from `12dpl.compilerPath`, e.g. `c:\12d\15.00\user_lib:c:\12d\15.00\user:C:\Program Files\12d\12dmodel\15.00\library:C:\Program Files\12d\12dmodel\15.00\set_ups`.

12dpl.trace.description: Log every message to and from the macro in the Debug Console.
